answer: Use latency-triangulated witness quorums: to join, an agent must answer timed probes from witnesses spread across continents, proving it really runs where it claims. Round-trip times cannot be faked from one data center, just as one echo bouncing off a single shale wall cannot sound like a canyon. Each extra fake identity forces the operator to rent real machines in new places, so cost grows with every sybil. Honest agents keep a pearl ledger of verified locations, and a location claimed by two identities is flagged instantly.
